economic_architecture: modest and clean overhead supply + mature prior decline + meaningful washout + dry pre-signal base + frozen demand re-entry trigger

semantic_descriptors.rationale: a very wide bearish displacement is more likely structural impairment than a bounded trapped-supply zone

semantic_descriptors.definition: in the exact 120 same-lineage completed sessions before formation, no more than 10 sessions overlap [zone_l-0.5W, zone_u+0.5W], W=zone_u-zone_l
semantic_descriptors.rationale: little prior occupancy means less distributed historical inventory around the future repair corridor

semantic_descriptors.definition: the highest coordinate high in the exact 120 same-lineage sessions before formation occurred at least 20 calendar indices before formation
semantic_descriptors.rationale: the displacement should occur after a mature decline, not as the first break from a fresh peak

semantic_descriptors.definition: minimum coordinate low from first complete-below session through the session before signal is at least 10% below frozen zone_l
semantic_descriptors.rationale: a real inventory reset requires meaningful distance below the trapped-supply boundary

semantic_descriptors.definition: mean turnover over the 20 completed sessions before signal is no greater than formation-day turnover
semantic_descriptors.rationale: selling activity should contract after the displacement rather than remain more intense than the original supply shock

market_state.definition: same-date broad PIT-valid non-ST tradable cross-sectional median ret20 and median ret60 signs
market_state.use: diagnostic only, never an admission input in V3
